data.title: Support FAQ and guide index
data.label: Public
data.content: Public FAQ. Support hours: Monday-Friday, 08:00-18:00 UTC. Guide index by topic: onboarding and initial workspace setup -> G-01; single sign-on (SSO) setup -> G-02; billing address or invoice corrections -> G-03.

data.subject: Onboarding help
data.body: Hi team, we need help with onboarding. Our admins have not been able to finish the initial workspace setup. Could someone walk us through it this week? Thanks, Priya (Northwind Robotics)
data.label: Internal

data.title: Onboarding setup guide
data.label: Internal
data.content: Step 1: Confirm the customer's workspace admin contact. Step 2: Schedule a 30-minute setup session. Step 3: Walk the admin through workspace creation and user invitations. Step 4: Record completion in the follow-up ticket.

data.title: Billing correction procedure
data.label: Internal
data.content: Step 1: Verify that the requester is a billing contact on the account. Step 2: Update the billing address in the billing system. Step 3: Reissue the affected invoice and confirm with the customer.

data.title: SSO setup guide
data.label: Internal
data.content: Step 1: Confirm the customer's identity provider and protocol (for example SAML 2.0). Step 2: Exchange identity-provider metadata. Step 3: Test sign-in with one pilot user. Step 4: Enable SSO for all users.
